payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene

payload.content: Hi all, I'm Raylene (backend:0.85, availability 8h). My costs strongly favor ISSUE-0002 tasks: review=1.90, test=2.66, implement=3.80. My ISSUE-0001 costs are all 10-20, so I'd be very inefficient there. I'd like to claim ISSUE-0002::review (my lowest cost). If someone else has a strong claim on that, I can fall back to ISSUE-0002::test or ::implement. Please post your intended claims so we avoid duplicates.

Hi all, Maya here (mobile-development:0.77, api-development:0.64, availability 10h). My private costs:

ISSUE-0002::review=2.06, ISSUE-0002::test=2.89, ISSUE-0002::implement=4.12
ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage=2.39, ISSUE-0001::test=3.35, ISSUE-0001::implement=4.78

Goal: cover the 3 medium-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks first (highest priority), then a low one.

Raylene: you have a comparative advantage on ISSUE-0002::implement (your 3.80 vs my 4.12 is a 0.32 gap, vs only 0.16 gap on review). So the joint-cost-minimizing split of the two is:
- Maya: ISSUE-0002::review (2.06)
- Raylene: ISSUE-0002::implement (3.80)  -> combined 5.86
(alternative: Raylene review 1.90 + Maya implement 4.12 = 6.02, so the above is cheaper)

Proposed plan:
- Maya -> ISSUE-0002::review
- Raylene -> ISSUE-0002::implement (or ::test if you strongly prefer; I can flex)
- Gerda / Mackenzie -> please post your claims; ideally one of you takes ISSUE-0002::test (medium) and the other a low ISSUE-0001 task.

I'll hold off committing until we hear from Gerda and Mackenzie. Please post your intended claims.

Hi all, Gerda here (backend:0.72, availability 5h). My private costs:
ISSUE-0002::review=2.18, ISSUE-0002::test=3.06, ISSUE-0002::implement=4.37
ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage=10.00, ISSUE-0001::test=14.00, ISSUE-0001::implement=20.00

I'm very inefficient on all ISSUE-0001 tasks (cost >=10), so I should take an ISSUE-0002 task. Given Maya -> ISSUE-0002::review and Raylene -> ISSUE-0002::implement, the natural fit is:
- Gerda -> ISSUE-0002::test (cost 3.06)

That covers all three medium-priority ISSUE-0002 tasks. Mackenzie: please take a low ISSUE-0001 task (my costs there are prohibitive, so I'd be a bad choice). I'll plan to commit ISSUE-0002::test unless someone objects. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raylene here. I agree with the plan and will commit ISSUE-0002::implement (cost 3.80). Rationale confirms Maya's math: my comparative advantage is largest on implement, so it's jointly cheapest for me to take implement while Maya takes review.

Locking in:
- Maya -> ISSUE-0002::review (2.06)
- Raylene -> ISSUE-0002::implement (3.80)
- Gerda -> ISSUE-0002::test (3.06)
- Mackenzie -> one low-priority ISSUE-0001 task (review/docs/triage are all effort 1.0, priority low) — please post your pick so we don't collide.

This covers all 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low task = 4 tasks done. No duplicates. Mackenzie, if you have no strong preference, ISSUE-0001::triage or ::docs is fine. I'll commit ISSUE-0002::implement in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Maya here — confirming and locking my claim: Maya -> ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.06). Agreed with the joint split (Maya review 2.06 + Raylene implement 3.80 = 5.86, cheaper than the swap). Gerda -> ISSUE-0002::test, Mackenzie -> a low ISSUE-0001 task (triage/docs/review). This covers all 3 medium ISSUE-0002 tasks + 1 low task with no duplicates. I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution. Mackenzie, please post your pick.

Mackenzie here (mobile-development:0.62, availability 5h). My private costs:

ISSUE-0002::review=2.44, ISSUE-0002::test=3.42, ISSUE-0002::implement=4.88
ISSUE-0001::review=10.00, ISSUE-0001::docs=10.00, ISSUE-0001::triage=10.00, ISSUE-0001::test=14.00, ISSUE-0001::implement=20.00

I agree with the joint plan. My ISSUE-0002 costs (2.44/3.42/4.88) are all above the current claimants' costs (Maya review 2.06, Gerda test 3.06, Raylene implement 3.80), so reassigning one of those to me would only raise total cost — no gain. Taking a low ISSUE-0001 task at 10.00 is the cheapest way to add a 4th completed task.

My ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage are all identical (cost 10.00, effort 1.0, low priority), so no collision risk matters. I'll claim ISSUE-0001::triage to avoid clashing with any late docs/review interest.

Locking in:
- Maya -> ISSUE-0002::review
- Raylene -> ISSUE-0002::implement
- Gerda -> ISSUE-0002::test
- Mackenzie -> ISSUE-0001::triage

All 3 medium tasks + 1 low task covered, no duplicates. Please flag if anything changes. (phase=planning, iter=1)
